fusions.name: From Across the Room
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and bite, dealing 15 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bites Everywhere at Once
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you takes 3 poison damage and has a 35% chance to become [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with 15% more dodge chance, and your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Strike on Landing
fusions.desc: After you cover ground, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
